ideas.pitch: A multi-agent agricultural diagnostic platform that processes drone imagery and IoT soil telemetry to generate localized treatment plans.
ideas.problem_statement: Applied Research and Sustainability in regional agriculture facing crop yield loss due to delayed disease identification.
ideas.title: AgriSense: Autonomous Crop Disease Diagnostic & Treatment Loop
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the applied research and sustainability domains requested by the hackathon while utilizing a multi-agent closed-loop operations pattern inspired by winning IoT and AI architectures.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered training platform for medical students that conducts simulated patient diagnostic interviews and evaluates CPR performance using pose estimation.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare training gaps where students lack accessible, objective practice tools for patient communication and emergency resuscitation.
ideas.title: MedPrep AI: Clinical OSCE & CPR Examiner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven grand-prize-winning architecture from AI healthcare hackathons, focusing on a demonstrable live CV and LLM pipeline that immediately captivates judges.

ideas.pitch: A real-time community engagement dashboard that aggregates infrastructure complaints via GPS and automates local economic marketing copilot tools for town councils.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Systems and municipal inefficiencies in citizen-to-government communication and local merchant engagement.
ideas.title: CivicTrack: Municipal Issue Triage & Local Business Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs a clear civic-tech impact pattern that won first place at real-world impact hackathons by combining live mapping dashboards with localized AI generation.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent auditing system that reviews automated microfinance loan applications and lending decisions to flag algorithmic discrimination and compliance errors.
ideas.problem_statement: Applied Research in algorithmic fairness and transparent financial inclusion for underserved undergraduate populations.
ideas.title: AuditFlow AI: Automated Loan Decision Bias Checker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a proven first-place winning formula for algorithmic bias evaluation, appealing directly to the applied research and rigorous evaluation expectations of the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-enabled edge computer vision classifier and simulator that sorts recyclable waste streams using custom-trained models and automated sorting feedback.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainability and waste management infrastructure challenges in dense urban campuses and educational institutions.
ideas.title: EcoSort Robotics: Smart Vision Waste Categorizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical robotics simulation and practical computer vision matching a proven runner-up formula that scores high on tangible hardware-software integration.
